stalls.summaryZh: 台式炸雞皮薄酥脆、肉汁多，口味偏重但不死鹹；用餐時段常排隊。

stalls.summaryEn: Charcoal-grilled pork in a soft bun, including indigenous-style salted pork, with egg, pickled greens and peanut powder. Big portion; sometimes a little charred.
